test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting a around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). B sits third to the right of A. A is second to the right of C. Only two persons sits between C and E. H sits second to the left of D. F is not the neighbour of C or E.

Who is sitting third to the left of G?
solution:
Given: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting a around a circular table facing towards the centre.

According to the given statement, we have:

1) B sits third to the right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45f18cad7a8de4adc16cae0fd90223e0758f116f153d90a5f5e865ee0b56d9dd.png] 

2) A is second to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7a4a6f7a29667d920e20dadd304d32e997d05053dadcb2445a90459e718cc14.png] 

3) Only two persons sits between C and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9af6d15beca9b24770f5947933342c90a2441ba073412698c38b1600caba762.png] 

4) F is not the neighbour of C or E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a7eced2cd800ce2e589ec735edba8068e2dc25a3f6dcfc785d3898a3388af96.png] 

5) H sits second to the left of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/894340a0f187bb921ddfa5849b28e5aaff22f9d4c2c22d454d6a8e98d14a0e85.png] 

Thus, the final sitting arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a37b647f0bd76cdd6dea9a5bebcb6b7851d1dc0d8eb2429421d36c62df840d8.png] 

Hence, '__**D**__' is sitting third to the left of G.
